items.title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
items.summary: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.

items.title: Samsung Wallet launches USDC accounts on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.summary: Samsung Wallet's Stablecoin Account is now live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, allowing them to use USDC on Solana.

items.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
items.summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

items.title: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge
items.summary: The $1 trillion-plus asset manager brings its emerging markets bond strategy to Solana, expanding the range of onchain actively managed funds.

items.title: Introducing the Parsed Events Scan API
items.summary: Scan any wallet on Solana using server-side filters for programs, instructions, token mint addresses, and only pay for what you scan.

items.title: Agave 4.4 Update: All You Need to Know
items.summary: A roundup of the most important features and performance upgrades in the Solana Agave 4.4 validator client release.

items.title: The Price of Cheap Writes: How does RocksDB read?
items.summary: RocksDB reads newest to oldest, stopping at the first version it finds. Learn how bloom filters, the block cache, and prefix seeks keep that search fast.
